correctness.rationale: The tree-independent-edge coupling gives exact generation-tail recursion. Prüfer bijection enumerates every labeled finite tree through n=7; canonical codes classify rooted isomorphism; all 84 class representatives are checked. Exact symbolic derivative-root counts on the open interval find no type with two roots through six vertices and precisely one at seven. Independently, direct summation over each open-edge mask reproduces every class polynomial. The unique witness derivative equals -12p²+12p-2, with simple roots (3±√3)/6 and the claimed signs. The conclusion does not extrapolate beyond n=7.

value.rationale: Transmission probability is the direct control lever in the canonical one-generation SIR model. Expected final generation is a meaningful extinction-time proxy, and its curvature determines whether the marginal duration response to changing transmission is increasing or decreasing. A sharp unique smallest tree with two curvature reversals, contrasting with universally convex expected outbreak size, reveals the interaction of parallel and serial exposure routes. The cut-off is natural and complete, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
